extra.description: Endpoint accuracy on abstract-reasoning benchmarks does not reveal whether a language model has acquired a transferable rule or fit distribution-specific regularities. We study this distinction in small language models on the ARC-TGI benchmark, which organizes abstract grid transformations into controllable task families and supports resampling, spatial shifts, and cross-benchmark transfer. Across more than 1,000 runs, we profile decoder-only, encoder--decoder, and mixture-of-experts model families under supervised fine-tuning. We examine the efficiency and stability of skill acquisition, robustness beyond the training distribution, interactions with model family and task formulation, and layer-wise attention signatures that accompany behavioral differences. Substantial in-distribution accuracy is attainable, but acquisition is sensitive to optimization and unevenly distributed across task families. Performance deteriorates sharply outside the training distribution, including when the rule is retained but grid scale changes. Greater training-set depth and breadth yield uneven gains, while the effect of additional in-context examples depends on model family. Executable-rule induction also yields correct solutions not observed under direct grid generation. On selected tasks, attention diagnostics show distinct concentration and context-dependence profiles, but do not establish general causal mechanisms. Overall, abstract-reasoning scores are conditional on the model, adaptation regime, evaluation distribution, and response format.

items.title: Secure Speculative Decoding for Large Language Models
items.title_zh: 大语言模型的安全推测解码
items.summary_zh: 推测解码通过先使用一个较小的模型（称为\emph{草稿模型}）生成候选token，然后用目标模型验证其接受或拒绝，来加速大语言模型（LLM，称为\emph{目标模型}）的推理。先前研究主要关注推测解码的效率-效用权衡，如有损推测解码，而其安全影响在很大程度上未被探索。在这项工作中，我们通过提供\emph{首个}对推测解码安全影响的系统性研究来弥合这一空白。通过大规模测量研究，我们揭示了一种明显的安全-效用不对称性：在广泛的有损推测解码方法中，推理效率的提升以不成比例的高安全代价换取，越狱和提示注入攻击的成功率上升速度远快于效用下降。然后我们提出SecureSD，一种新的理论指导的推测解码方法，在保持效率和效用的同时增强安全性。具体而言，我们的理论分析揭示，安全退化主要源于草稿模型生成的早期token。受此洞察启发，SecureSD对早期解码位置的草稿模型token应用更严格的验证标准。在安

extra.description: Speculative decoding accelerates inference for a large language model (LLM), referred to as the \emph{target model}, by first using a smaller model, referred to as the \emph{draft model}, to generate candidate tokens and then verifying them with the target model for acceptance or rejection. Prior studies primarily focused on the efficiency-utility trade-off of speculative decoding, e.g., lossy speculative decoding, leaving its security implications largely unexplored. In this work, we bridge this gap by providing the \emph{first} systematic study of the security implications of speculative decoding. Through a large-scale measurement study, we reveal a pronounced security-utility asymmetry: across a wide range of lossy speculative decoding methods, improvements in inference efficiency come at a disproportionately high cost to security, with attack success rates for jailbreak and prompt injection attacks increasing much faster than utility degrades. We then propose SecureSD, a new theory-guided speculative decoding method that enhances security while maintaining efficiency and utility. Specifically, our theoretical analysis reveals that security degradation primarily originates from the early tokens generated by the draft model. Motivated by this insight, SecureSD applies a stricter verification criterion to draft-model tokens at early decoding positions. Extensive experiments on both security and utility benchmarks demonstrate that SecureSD significantly improves security while preserving efficiency and utility compared to existing speculative decoding methods.

items.title: Pervasive Backdoor Vulnerabilities in Genomic Foundation Models
items.title_zh: 基因组基础模型中普遍存在的后门漏洞
items.summary_zh: 基因组基础模型正在革新生物学研究和生物技术，然而其对数据投毒的脆弱性仍鲜有刻画。在此我们表明，仅需用短DNA基序（包括源自转座子末端反向重复序列（TIR）的触发序列）毒化一小部分训练数据，后门攻击就能在微调期间可靠地植入到不同模型架构、任务和模型规模中。基于编码器和自回归模型的攻击成功率普遍较高，而干净任务性能几乎不变。增加模型规模并未带来可测量的抵抗力。为检测此类威胁，我们开发了一个两阶段审计框架，通过模型预测中局部单核苷酸突变敏感性来标记可能被毒化的序列，无需事先知道触发序列。这些结果将下游微调确定为基因组基础模型的攻击面，并推动更强的数据溯源、对抗评估和训练后安全审计。

extra.description: Genomic foundation models are revolutionizing biological research and biotechnology, yet their vulnerability to data poisoning remains poorly characterized. Here we show that backdoor attacks can be reliably implanted during fine-tuning across diverse model architectures, tasks and model scales by poisoning only a small fraction of training data with short DNA motifs, including triggers derived from transposon terminal inverted repeats (TIRs). Attack success rates are generally high across encoder-based and autoregressive models, while clean-task performance remains almost unchanged. Increasing model scale does not confer measurable resistance. To detect such threats, we develop a two-stage auditing framework that flags potentially poisoned sequences through localized single-nucleotide mutation sensitivity in model predictions, without prior knowledge of trigger sequences. These results identify downstream fine-tuning as an attack surface for genomic foundation models and motivate stronger data provenance, adversarial evaluation and post-training security auditing.

items.summary_zh: Nature Methods，在线发布：2026年10月5日；doi:10.1038/s41592-026-03237-0 CCI-seq利用组合细胞团索引和单细胞测序捕获大规模细胞-细胞交互网络。

extra.description: Nature Methods, Published online: 05 October 2026; doi:10.1038/s41592-026-03237-0 CCI-seq leverages combinatorial cell clump indexing and single-cell sequencing to capture large-scale cell–cell interaction networks.

items.title: Times are changing but order matters: transferable prediction of small-molecule liquid chromatography retention times
items.title_zh: 时代在变但顺序很重要：小分子液相色谱保留时间的可迁移预测
items.summary_zh: Nature Methods，在线发表：2026年10月1日；doi:10.1038/s41592-026-03243-2 提出了一种跨色谱条件和化合物类别的可迁移保留时间预测方法。该方法采用两步策略，首先预测条件感知的保留顺序指数，然后将其映射到绝对保留时间。

extra.description: Nature Methods, Published online: 01 October 2026; doi:10.1038/s41592-026-03243-2 A method for transferable retention time prediction across chromatographic conditions and compound classes is presented. The approach makes use of a two-step strategy that first predicts a condition-aware retention order index followed by mapping it to absolute retention times.

items.title: CytoVI: deep generative modeling of antibody-based single cell data
items.title_zh: CytoVI：基于抗体的单细胞数据的深度生成建模
items.summary_zh: Nature Methods，在线发表：2026年9月30日；doi:10.1038/s41592-026-03224-5 CytoVI是一个深度生成模型，用于对基于抗体的单细胞数据进行统计严谨的分析。

extra.description: Nature Methods, Published online: 30 September 2026; doi:10.1038/s41592-026-03224-5 CytoVI is a deep generative model for statistically rigorous analysis of antibody-based single-cell data.

items.title: Spatially resolved chromatin architectures in mammalian brain tissues
items.title_zh: 哺乳动物脑组织中的空间分辨染色质结构
items.summary_zh: Nature Methods，在线发表：2026 年 9 月 25 日；doi:10.1038/s41592-026-03218-3 空间 Hi-C 允许以空间分辨方式研究染色质组织。该方法显示了成年和发育中小鼠大脑的区域和细胞类型特异性差异。

extra.description: Nature Methods, Published online: 25 September 2026; doi:10.1038/s41592-026-03218-3 Spatial Hi-C allows the study of chromatin organization in a spatially resolved manner. This approach shows regional and cell-type-specific differences in the adult and developing mouse brain.

items.title: Control of ice thickness in cryo-EM via confinement
items.title_zh: 通过限域控制冷冻电镜中的冰厚度
items.summary_zh: Nature Methods，在线发表：2026 年 9 月 25 日；doi:10.1038/s41592-026-03244-1 本研究探索使用在穿孔支撑膜上形成的石墨烯储液池，作为在冷冻电镜样品制备过程中精确控制冰厚度的方法。

extra.description: Nature Methods, Published online: 25 September 2026; doi:10.1038/s41592-026-03244-1 This study explores the use of graphene reservoirs formed over perforated supporting films as a method to precisely control ice thickness during cryo-EM sample preparation.

items.title: ResolVI: addressing noise and bias in spatial transcriptomics
items.title_zh: ResolVI：解决空间转录组学中的噪声和偏差
items.summary_zh: Nature Methods，在线发表：2026年9月24日；doi:10.1038/s41592-026-03212-9 空间转录组学数据的分割和定量受到特定噪声和偏差的困扰。ResolVI通过生成经过误差和批次校正的空间转录组学数据概率表示来应对这一挑战，有助于在多个分析任务中提高性能。

extra.description: Nature Methods, Published online: 24 September 2026; doi:10.1038/s41592-026-03212-9 Segmentation and quantification of spatial transcriptomics data is plagued by specific noise and bias. ResolVI tackles this challenge by generating error- and batch-corrected probabilistic representations of spatial transcriptomics data, contributing to improved performance in multiple analysis tasks.
